instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Unit U21 (briefs/U21.md: add the arrowhead size tests before the final `});`) failed its vitest check on every attempt, so the file is still as it was before the run: add U21's tests. Failing test, verbatim: "element locking > arrowhead size > undoes and redoes arrowheadSize changes and copies/pastes arrowheadSize styles between arrows" -> AssertionError: expected 1.5 to be undefined, at `Keyboard.undo(); expect(getDrawn().isDeleted).toBe(false); expect(getDrawn().arrowheadSize).toBeUndefined();`. ROOT CAUSE (reproduced by the orchestrator in a scratch test): the arrow was created with `UI.createElement("arrow")` with no size, which leaves a 1-point arrow still being drawn (appState.multiElement and appState.newElement set). executeHistoryAction (actions/actionHistory.tsx:31-43) blocks undo/redo while multiElement/newElement are set, so undo does nothing. Pressing Escape instead deletes the 1-point arrow. The product code is correct: with `const arrow = UI.createElement("arrow", { x: 0, y: 0, size: 100 });` (the arrow is finished and selected, multiElement/newElement null), then `act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionChangeArrowheadSize, "ui", 1.5); })`, then `Keyboard.undo()`, the arrow has arrowheadSize undefined, `"arrowheadSize" in arrow` false, isDeleted false; `Keyboard.redo()` restores 1.5. So: create every arrow in these tests with an explicit size (`UI.createElement("arrow", { x, y, size: 100 })`, a different x/y per arrow), select the one to change (API.setSelectedElements) before each action, and do not call history/ElementsDelta internals or API.executeAction with a value (API.executeAction takes no value; use act(() => h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value))). Paste-styles part (AC-8), arrow to arrow only: (a) copy styles from an arrow with arrowheadSize 1.5, paste onto another arrow with none -> 1.5; (b) copy from an arrow with none, paste onto an arrow with 1.5 -> undefined. Copy/paste styles: select the source and run actionCopyStyles, select the target and run actionPasteStyles, each through h.app.actionManager.executeAction inside act.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
